title: Not what I expected
text:
Not what I expected. You really do get what you pay for and unfortunately, this offer is indeed, too good to be true. I really wish that I would have read the description more carefully: "Egyptian COMFORT" is not the same as "Egyptian COTTON".... make no mistake...these sheets are 100% polyester - they say so on the label. The sheets are paper thin and see-through. I am so disappointed. Will not make this mistake again.

You can buy genuine Egyptian cotton sheets all day everyday online for about $30 and they have every size. This was not a great deal, and if you want the feel of 1600tc cotton sheets you will be disappointed.
